name: ai-factory
description: Risk-proportional delivery factory for classifying work and running Small, Medium, or Large flows with QA and release gates.

interface.shortDescription: Classify work and run risk-proportional delivery flows.
interface.longDescription: AI Factory classifies a raw task, selects a Small, Medium, or Large delivery flow, and supplies artifacts, gates, QA, adversarial review, and human approval rules.
defaultPrompt: Use $ai-factory to classify this task and recommend a delivery flow.
Use $ai-factory to run the appropriate delivery flow for this feature.
